Joy dukh ko mitana nahi, balki usse upar uthna hai.
Aazadi kisi ki ijaazat ke bina aap khud hona hai.
Predictable se bhago; extraordinary dhoondo.
Azaad jiyo ya mar jao.
Joy zindagi ki ek behad badi bhavna hai.
Khushi pravah hai.
Azadi ek shaant mann hai.
Azadi durlabh hai.
Khushi dil ke andar ki roshni hai.
Khushi aapke zindagi ke nazariye ka parinam hai.
Azaadi pasand ka kaam karne mein nahi, balki sahi kaam karne ke haq mein hai.
Main koi pakshi nahi; aur koi jaal mujhe nahi baandhta; main azaad hoon.
Khushi activity ki ek sthiti hai.
Freedom crisp high-altitude air saans lena hai.
Aazadi discussion, dissent aur debate ke anvil par banti hai.
Khushi aatma ka naach hai.
Khushi achhi sehat aur kharab yaadash hai.
Azad rooh durlabh hoti hai.
Joy himmat ka badge hai.
Light pack karo, khul ke haso, azaad ghoomo.
Aazad hone ka aatm-sar doosron ke liye khud ko zanjeeron mein bandhna hai.
Khushi rooh ka sukoon hai.
Azadi bhagwan ka rasta hai.
Khushi ujjal hai.
Azaadi ek bhaari bojh, ek bada aur ajeeb bharam hai.
Khushi ek titli hai, jo piche bhagne par door rehti hai, par shant baithne par aap par baith sakti hai.
Khushi zindagi ki pakki swikriti hai.
